id: title:adamleithp:extract the nav product list into getnavproductitems

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the shared navigation item generation implementation, replacing an inline implementation with a dedicated module, while retaining the same deduplication and category assignment behavior.
review.reason: The change consolidates navigation item generation into a shared module, removing inline implementation and its dependencies. This is a localized refactoring and dependency cleanup rather than a substantive capability or systemic improvement.
review.uncertainty: The exact benefit of this refactoring is not demonstrated by the code; it could be a technical debt reduction or a preparation for future changes. No broader systemic benefit or critical path improvement is observable.

observations.limitations: This chunk represents a refactoring and consolidation of navigation item generation. P1.F1.H1 adds a new module P1.F1.H1, P1.F2.H1 removes the old implementation and its dependencies, P1.F2.H2 replaces the inline implementation with a call to the new module. No score assigned.

observations.posthog_connection: Provides a shared, reusable function for generating the navigation product items, including Home, Activity, Persons, and other tree items, while handling deduplication and category assignment.
